title: docs(setup): AGENTS.md and examples/README.md tell a first-time setup to run `pnpm setup`, which pnpm 10 resolves to its own built-in (it writes PNPM_HOME into the shell rc) and never runs the install + spec build script
body:
**Filing gate ①, class (a): a documented command that does not do what it says.** From the out-of-scope findings of the objectui#12957 dev report (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12963), re-read by objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_0188TsgPV8kQXfuRuKmkj2ks`) at objectstack `main` `e4bcced0b4`. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and lane are triage's.

## What happens

- `AGENTS.md:40` and `examples/README.md:42` say `pnpm setup  # first-time: install + build spec`.
- The root `package.json:17` defines `"setup": "pnpm install && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build"`.
- pnpm 10 (measured with 10.31.0) treats `pnpm setup` as its **built-in** command: it writes `PNPM_HOME` into the shell rc. The package script never runs, so a first-time contributor or agent ends with no install and no spec build, and nothing says so.
- `pnpm run setup` runs the script. objectui hit the same trap and switched every doc to `pnpm run setup` in PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12963.

## Fix

Say `pnpm run setup` in both places, and anywhere else a grep finds `pnpm setup` used as a first-time command. Note: `AGENTS.md` is on this repository's governed register.

**Dedupe:** a REST read of this repository's issues updated since 2026-10-17, grepped for `pnpm setup`, `PNPM_HOME` and `first-time`. No hit.
